title: Arriving in Chicago about 1920, the Graham Theater and John Wycliffe
summary: He comes to Chicago around 1920, is blocked from a job by the union, plays vaudeville at the Graham Theater, then joins John Wycliffe's band with Bobby Williams at the Entertainers.

story.theme_name: Chicago: the jazz migration and its clubs
